name: Log the first starts
description: For Windows 98's first five starts the startup menu shows for 3 seconds with 'Logged (\BOOTLOG.TXT)' as its default (Safe mode is a keypress away), and each start's log is kept in \98REBORN\LOGS as BOOT1.TXT to BOOT5.TXT, beside Setup's SETUPLOG.TXT and DETLOG.TXT and the installer's INSTALL.TXT. A start that froze is kept too: its log is saved on the next start. Then the normal startup settings come back. Applied automatically by the installer.

ops.comment: The startup settings to restore after five logged starts (the edition's own, e.g. the gaming startup menu).

lines: IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\NUL MD C:\98REBORN
IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\NUL MD C:\98REBORN\LOGS
FOR %%F IN (BOOTLOG.PRV SETUPLOG.TXT DETLOG.TXT) DO IF EXIST C:\%%F C:\{{windir}}\COMMAND\ATTRIB.EXE -R -S -H C:\%%F
IF EXIST C:\SETUPLOG.TXT IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\SETUPLOG.TXT COPY C:\SETUPLOG.TXT C:\98REBORN\LOGS >NUL
IF EXIST C:\DETLOG.TXT IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\DETLOG.TXT COPY C:\DETLOG.TXT C:\98REBORN\LOGS >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\LOGGED.FLG IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT4.TXT IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT5.TXT COPY C:\BOOTLOG.PRV C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT5.TXT >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\LOGGED.FLG IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT3.TXT IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT4.TXT COPY C:\BOOTLOG.PRV C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT4.TXT >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\LOGGED.FLG IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT2.TXT IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT3.TXT COPY C:\BOOTLOG.PRV C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT3.TXT >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\LOGGED.FLG IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT1.TXT IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT2.TXT COPY C:\BOOTLOG.PRV C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT2.TXT >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\LOGGED.FLG IF NOT EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT1.TXT COPY C:\BOOTLOG.PRV C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT1.TXT >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT5.TXT IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM C:\{{windir}}\COMMAND\ATTRIB.EXE -R -S -H C:\MSDOS.SYS
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT5.TXT IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM COPY C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM C:\MSDOS.SYS >NUL
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT5.TXT IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM C:\{{windir}}\COMMAND\ATTRIB.EXE +R +S +H C:\MSDOS.SYS
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\LOGS\BOOT5.TXT IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM DEL C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM
IF EXIST C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM COPY C:\98REBORN\MSDOS.NRM C:\98REBORN\LOGS\LOGGED.FLG >NUL
ops.comment: Windows marks its logs hidden and system, which COPY skips, so they're unhidden first. A logged start renames the last start's BOOTLOG.TXT to BOOTLOG.PRV before this runs, so that's the one kept. The flag is made with COPY: DOS opens an IF line's redirection even when the IF is false.
